purpose: Rank components by expected or tail-risk loss under a defensible, externally supplied scenario distribution.
unlock_rule: Disabled until scenario states and normalised non-negative weights are supplied; the platform will not fabricate probabilities.

primary_sources.citation: Berdica (2002), An introduction to road vulnerability, Transport Policy.
Bell (2000), A game theory approach to measuring transport network performance reliability, Transportation Research Part B.
Chen, Yang, Lo and Tang (2002), Capacity reliability of a road network, Transportation Research Part B.

known_limitations: Expected loss and tail risk answer different questions.
Large scenario-component products can be computationally expensive.
